visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short dark hair wearing a blue and white plaid shirt smiles at the camera while holding two orange tubes of sauce. The background shows a brightly lit retail environment with wooden accents. (2) Close-up shot of two hands holding the same orange tubes, displaying Japanese text and a logo on the packaging. (3) The scene shifts to the exterior of a shop with vertical wooden slats and a red logo. A white sign with Japanese text stands out front. (4) Interior shot of a bakery rack featuring various breads. A hand reaches in to touch a piece of sliced baguette topped with a reddish spread. (5) A woman with dark hair in a ponytail tastes a sample of sauce using a small white swab in a well-lit indoor shop setting. (6) The man in the plaid shirt is seen tasting the sauce from a swab, making an appreciative facial expression. (7) A yellow subway directional sign appears, showing numbers 1, 2, and 3, indicating the Gion station exit. (8) The camera pans over refrigerated display cases containing various types of pink mentaiko (pollock roe) in ornate bowls and boxes. (9) A close-up shows a person's hands holding several orange tubes of sauce on a wooden table, followed by a staff member in a black uniform and mask placing them into a silver thermal bag. (10) The man holds a small green jar with a white label while the background shows a shop counter. (11) A montage shows several different people in home settings eating toast or noodles topped with the orange sauce, expressing enjoyment through smiles and nodding.

(2) A sharp 'ding' sound effect triggers as the narration highlights the shop's popularity. (3) A soft crunching sound of paper bags is heard as the camera focuses on the bakery. (4) A female voice exclaims '很濃喔' (It's very rich!) with high pitch and excitement, followed by a short cartoon-like 'sparkle' SFX. (5) Transition SFX resembling a digital 'whoosh' plays between location shifts. (6) Sounds of plastic rustling and items being placed on a counter accompany the transaction scene. (7) Multiple female voices overlap at the end shouting '真假啦!' (Really?!) repeatedly in a rhythmic, chanting fashion with laughter tracks mixed in, creating a high-arousal comedic atmosphere.
